feeds.title: Library Girl and Book Boy » Friendship
feeds.description: Get into their blog and learn more about workshops, events, books, articles, reviews, and more. Library Girl and Book Boy blog is owned and operated by Jo, an English teacher and manager. Through her blog, she aims to introduce children, their families, teachers, and book lovers to books they may not have come across before but would enjoy reading or using in their school curriculums.

feeds.title: We Read Tween Books » Friendship
feeds.description: Dive into their blog and learn more about books, series, novels, new releases, articles, and more. We Read Tween Books by Leslie, helps kids become lifelong readers by finding the best chapter book series and graphic novels worth reading. They believe that chapter book series and graphic novels are the best tween books worth reading and are the best avenue for inspiring a love of reading in your child.

feeds.title: Reading Ladies » Friendship
feeds.description: Walk through her blog and learn more about books, resources, recommendations, reviews, articles, projects, and more. Reading Ladies' blog is owned and operated by Carol, a retired 5th-grade teacher, an ardent and avid bibliophile, a literacy advocate, and her favorite genres are historical fiction, literary fiction, and contemporary fiction. The mission of her blog is to share a love of great literature across a variety of genres with an intentional focus on new releases, thoughtful themes, diverse cultures, and own voices authors.

feeds.title: The Baby Bookworm » Friendship
feeds.description: Take a look through their blog and learn more about friendship books, resources, articles, reviews, and more. JJ and Mama started The Baby Bookworm, a review blog across multiple platforms, to share their literary adventures with other young book lovers. Their blog started as a way to keep track of the books they read, but they ended up finding lots of friends who wanted to know what books were right for their little ones.

feeds.title: Pickle Me This » Friends
feeds.description: Discover more about the latest updates, releases, books, articles, and more from her bog. Pickle Me This blog is owned and managed by Kerry Clare, a National Magazine award-nominated essayist and editor of the Canadian books website 49thShelf.com, she writes about books and reading on her longtime blog. She lives in Toronto with her family. Through her work, she inspires readers and writers to grow, learn, and explore through engagement with books and storytelling.

feeds.title: Theresa Smith Writes » Friendship
feeds.description: Wade through her blog and learn more about friendship books, articles, reviews, and more. Theresa Smith is a writer, avid reader, keen reviewer, book collector, drinker of all tea blends originating from Earl Grey, and modern history enthusiast. She enjoys reading many genres but has a particular interest in historical fiction.

feeds.title: Free Kids Books » Friendship
feeds.description: Visit their blog and learn more about publishers, authors, books, stories, articles, and more. Free Kids Books is a growing library of unique children's books, literary resources, and textbooks for children and young adults, available online and for download primarily in a user-friendly PDF format. They aim to provide easy access to great free children's books and educational resources, for the enjoyment of reading and writing, and to promote improved literacy and education, and thus improved lives.
